sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold White Dial Crystal Bracelet Watch for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a touch of timeless elegance to your look with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a classic white dial with Roman numeral detailing and a beautiful crystal-inspired bracelet design. The combination of the elegant gold-tone finish, soft white dial and translucent crystal accents creates a sophisticated jewellery-inspired look.
The unique oval-shaped dial and decorative bracelet make this watch a stylish statement accessory, perfect for women who love vintage-inspired pieces with a luxurious finish. It effortlessly complements both traditional and western outfits.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired jewellery watch
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- 🤍 Elegant white dial
- 🕰️ Classic Roman numeral hour markers
- 💎 Translucent crystal-style bracelet detailing
- 🔗 Unique decorative link bracelet
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 🌸 Jewellery-inspired statement design
- 👗 Easy to style with ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Perfect gifting option for women
Perfect For
Festive occasions, weddings, parties, office wear, date nights, casual outings and everyday styling.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
